name: Default
shortDescription: OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech API and web player for the Kokoro-82M model, running on CPU.

alerts.message: The domain root answers Not Found. Open /web for the player and /docs for the API reference.
The API and web player are public by default, so anyone with the URL can generate speech. Set API_KEYS to a JSON list of keys to require authentication; the web player then stops working.
